CheckTitle: MFA re-prompt interval is not effectively unlimited
Description: Checks broad global session rules for bounded MFA re-prompt behavior.
Risk: Very long MFA lifetimes can make MFA effectively one-time for persistent sessions.

Code.Other:
1. In the Okta Admin Console, open the global session or Okta sign-on policy.
2. Edit rules that require MFA.
3. Set users to be prompted for MFA at every sign-in attempt or within the approved interval.
4. Align MFA lifetime with the maximum session lifetime.
5. Save and test the prompt behavior with a pilot user.

Recommendation.Text: Require MFA re-prompt at a bounded interval instead of allowing effectively unlimited MFA lifetime.

Notes: Requires the Okta read scopes documented for the referenced management APIs.
